'''Dartan Ziemba''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] who gave the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] a tip about a [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Force-sensitive toddler]] living on Alderaan. He had a wife named [[Sona Ziemba|Sona]] and a daughter named [[Tula Ziemba|Tula]].
